selected_evidence.requirement: Serve the inventory application over TCP/8181 while mandatory access control remains enforcing
selected_evidence.summary: Direct checks show SELinux Enforcing, httpd running under httpd_t, TCP/8181 labeled http_port_t and listening, the firewall port open, and the inventory application returning HTTP 200.

Healthy baseline boot ID was 6bb7e004-1e2e-46ac-bfd7-fafa248a4e76; reboot scheduling was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to d3dd3da3-3fa8-48e7-ac0e-5ab6ede57337; final checks prove SELinux, httpd, listener, firewall configuration, SELinux labeling, process context, and application content recovered.
